description:
Hyeon-Jin is a devil—literally. But not a very well-fed one. Without a proper source of spiritual energy, he’s constantly starving. At a broadcast station party, his luck finally seems to turn when two smoking-hot celebrities—top actor Seon-Wu and elite model Ha-Jun—start flirting with him. Jackpot, right? Desperate, Hyeon-Jin gives in, hoping to drain a little energy and dash. Except…

*“You're a demon, aren't you?”*

Uh-oh. Turns out Seon-Wu and Ha-Jun are actually angels. Sexy, powerful, and way too smug about it. Instead of smiting him, they offer Hyeon-Jin a deal he can't refuse—one that involves lots of close contact, a suspicious amount of cuddling, and... were those feathers?? Now stuck between two heavenly bodies with very unholy intentions, Hyeon-Jin wonders: Since when were angels this into corrupting demons?!

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*
